Cache key includes owner, profile.version, criteria_version, job_text; unchanged input reuses even 0/None. Exceptions from compute propagate and are not cached. Preserve signature.

Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.
